2026-09-24 09:3xZ ops-triage: MEASURED THE MISSING NUMBER -- discovery is ZERO, and the pipeline's levers cannot change that. Instagram's account-level insights answer reach with breakdown=follow_type (probed live read-only this pass: reach=6, FOLLOWER=6, and NO NON_FOLLOWER row; media-level reach rejects the breakdown, account-level accepts it). That number is now collected with every follower snapshot: growth_snapshots 1051 (09-24 05:36Z) = followers 157, follower_reach 6, non_follower_reach 0, reach_total 6, profile_views 0. So nothing outside the follower list is being shown these posts at all -- a DISTRIBUTION ceiling stated by the platform, not inferred from per-post sums, and 0 profile visits means no funnel step from reach to a follow either. Supporting cadence measurement (DB, weekly, insights-bearing posts): total weekly reach 139-149 at 23-42 posts/week vs 36 at 3 posts, while per-post reach is 12.0 at 3 posts and 3.1-3.3 at 13-42 -- i.e. volume spreads a ~150/week ceiling across more posts without adding reach or a single follower (followers 150->157 over 08-26..09-14, then flat at 157 for 10 days). DECISION (mine, recorded here rather than deferred): (1) the growth thesis's mechanism -- publish -> discovery -> follows -- has no discovery step on this account, so no content/caption/hashtag/cadence edit can move followers; those levers are measured INERT, and cadence is left at the configured cap (raising it is the one change the data says is actively harmful to per-post visibility). (2) The pre-registered follower leg is already DETERMINISTICALLY failed (157 vs the 170 ceiling; it needs +13 in the 11 days to the 10-05 read at an achieved 0.07/day), and the 10-05 engagement leg will now read on a valid cohort (5/5 feasible, gate-cohort-starved), so the 10-05 read cannot be :go or :continue and the gate's own pivot candidate is what fires. (3) PIVOT PRE-REGISTERED (before any build, per the gate discipline): the discovery arm is REELS/MOTION cut from renders we already produce -- the one organic Instagram surface with non-follower distribution, publishable on the SAME account and API (media_type=REELS) with no credential or platform change, so it is NOT a Tim ask. Its success metric is the account-level non_follower_reach now collected on every snapshot (self-closing criterion: non_follower_reach > 0), NOT engagement -- engagement is the wrong read for an account with no discovery. This item stays OPEN as the gate's continuously-tracked acceptance counter and self-closes on the first engaged post.

2026-09-24 06:3xZ ops-triage: THE PIVOT WAS BUILT (commit 5b446f1), because the decision was already made and re-deriving it every pass is the failure this loop exists to end. Machinery: Growth::ReelBuilder composes 2..8 existing renders into a 1080x1920 H.264/yuv420p MP4 (slow zoom per still, crossfades, 4:5 padded onto a blurred cover-scaled copy rather than centre-cropped so no subject is cut) and embeds the IPTC synthetic mark in the container metadata -- verified on photos 362/363/364: ffprobe h264 1080x1920 yuv420p 30/1, duration 8.000s == 3x3.0s - 2x0.5s crossfade, format_tags carry Iptc4xmpExt:DigitalSourceType=trainedAlgorithmicMedia; Instagram::Client#create_reel publishes it as a media_type=REELS video container, sharing the caption, the AI self-disclosure and the publish retry, with a 30x10s ready-check because a video container is transcoded. The still path is provably unchanged (media_type is sent only when it differs from the default). DELIBERATELY NOT ARMED, and the sequencing is the decision rather than an omission: Growth::GateRead#cohort_size counts posts published inside the review window that join a photo AND carry collected insights, so publishing a NEW FORMAT into the window the pre-registered read measures would inject an uncontrolled variable into that read own cohort -- the arm waits for the 2026-10-05 13:00Z read it was sequenced after. Recorded in openspec/changes/add-reel-discovery-arm (validated --strict) and guarded by a new check, check_reel_arm_stall, which is silent while sequenced, silent when armed, silent once non_follower_reach>0, and warns only if the read has passed with no production caller -- so a decided-and-built pivot cannot be silently dropped. Its own live run caught its first false positive (the client NAMES ReelBuilder in prose; the scan now strips Ruby comments). ITEM STAYS OPEN: it is the gate continuously-tracked acceptance counter and self-closes on the first engaged published post. Metric for the arm remains the collected non_follower_reach (latest measured 0), NOT engagement.
